title: When New Generators Arrive: Lifelong Machine-Generated Text Attribution via Ridge Feature Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2606.05626v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine-generated text (MGT) attribution aims to identify the specific generator responsible for a given text, thereby providing fine-grained evidence for model accountability and misuse investigation. As new large language models continue to emerge, attribution models must continuously incorporate new generators while preserving their ability to recognize previously seen ones. Prior works have shown that this lifelong MGT attribution setting is challenging, and existing methods often struggle to achieve a stable balance between adapting to new classes and retaining old ones. To address this issue, we propose RidgeFT, a lightweight analytic update framework that does not rely on exemplar replay. RidgeFT trains a task-aware encoder on the initial generator set, stores compact class-wise sufficient statistics when each generator class is first observed, and then freezes the encoder for replay-free closed-form updates. translated_title: 当新生成器到来时：基于岭回归特征迁移的终身机器生成文本溯源
translated_abstract: 机器生成文本（MGT）溯源旨在识别生成给定文本的具体生成器，从而为模型问责和滥用调查提供细粒度的证据。随着新的大语言模型不断涌现，溯源模型必须在保持识别先前已见生成器能力的同时，持续纳入新生成器。先前的研究表明，这种终身MGT溯源设置极具挑战性，现有方法往往难以在适应新类别与保留旧类别之间实现稳定的平衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RidgeFT，一个不依赖样本重放的轻量级解析式更新框架。RidgeFT在初始生成器集合上训练一个任务感知编码器，在首次观察到每个生成器类别时存储紧凑的类级充分统计量，随后冻结编码器以进行无需重放的闭式更新，进而……
tldr: 提出RidgeFT框架，通过在首次遇到每个生成器时存储紧凑的类级充分统计量，并以冻结编码器后无需样本重放的闭式解析更新方式，解决了终身机器生成文本溯源中适应新生成器与保留旧生成器能力的平衡难题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RidgeFT, a lightweight analytic update framework that stores compact class-wise sufficient statistics upon first encountering each generator and performs replay-free closed-form updates with a frozen encoder, addressing the stability-plasticity balance challenge in lifelong machine-generated text attribution.
